summary: One critical figure misidentification (M101 vs M33 for Pinwheel galaxy) and one major omission (part B of Problem 1 missing from answer field); otherwise text transcription is largely accurate with minor formatting inconsistencies.

defects.description: Problem 1's answer field mentions parts A and V but omits part B entirely. Part B requires listing 6 constellations through which the Milky Way passes. The answer goes directly from part A to part V.
defects.suggestedFix: Add part B answer: 'B) Six constellations through which the Milky Way passes (multiple correct combinations possible - see attached map with Milky Way and constellation boundaries).'

defects.description: Figure p3-fig3 (spiral galaxy viewed from above) is identified as M101 (Pinwheel) but according to the solutions page, this figure shows M33 (Pinwheel galaxy). The crop shows a spiral galaxy matching M33, not M101. While both are sometimes called Pinwheel, the correct identification from solutions is M33.
defects.suggestedFix: Black and white image of a spiral galaxy viewed from above (M33, Pinwheel), in the upper left frame of the page.

defects.description: Problem 4, part 4 table header shows Vyd:: (double colon) instead of Vyd: (single colon). While this matches the source text layer and may be a source error, it is a formatting anomaly that should be corrected for proper rendering.
defects.suggestedFix: Change double colon to single colon in table header

defects.description: Problem 2, Part A uses singular form instead of plural form of 'koji'. The candidate transcribed from solutions file per its caveat, which contains this form. This reflects a source inconsistency between problems and solutions documents.
